definitions.explanation: Money provided by a government or organization to support a specific activity, project, or group.

examples.japanese: {助成金|じょせいきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}する→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧。
⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{助成金|じょせいきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: The research grant has been decided.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{助成金|じょせいきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧、⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子育|こそだ}て→子育て：12226_kosodate⟧⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧⟦プログラム→プログラム：01540_puroguramu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: We received a grant from the city and started a community childcare support program.

notes:
{助成金|じょせいきん} refers to financial support from public or private organizations for specific purposes.

FORMS:
⟦{助成|じょせい}→助成：21479_josei⟧ (assistance, support) + {金|きん} (money)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {助成金|じょせいきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}する→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧: to apply for a grant
- {助成金|じょせいきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive a grant
- {助成金|じょせいきん}{制度|せいど}: grant system

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{補助金|ほじょきん}→補助金：19222_hojokin⟧: subsidy (government funding, often larger scale)
- {助成金|じょせいきん}: grant (for specific projects/activities)
- ⟦{奨学金|しょうがくきん}→奨学金：03230_shougakukin⟧: scholarship (for education)
